facts.text: Languages spoken here include Kinyarwanda, English and French.
It is a landlocked country in Eastern Africa.

culture.text: Imigongo is a geometric decorative art from eastern Rwanda, traditionally made using cow dung.

food.name: Brochettes
food.text: Grilled skewers, often goat, are commonly served with fries or cooked starchy bananas.
